sections.title: Summary
paragraphs: Data Scientist and applied researcher with experience in statistical modelling, machine learning, and large-scale health and administrative data analysis within national statistics and clinical research institutions. My work has focused on causal inference, longitudinal data analysis, and reproducible data science for public health applications. I am interested in developing statistical and machine learning methods for population health, clinical decision support, and real-world healthcare data.

sections.title: Research interests
paragraphs: My research interests include causal inference, interrupted time series analysis, implementation science, and machine learning for healthcare. I am particularly interested in developing trustworthy AI methods, including locally fine-tuned large language models (LLMs), to support clinical decision-making, population health, and the analysis of real-world healthcare data.

entries.title: DATA SCIENTIST
lines: Responsible for integrated antimicrobial stewardship (AMS) dashboard development and data workflow optimisation.

points.label: Dashboard Engineering & Data Integration
points.text: Developed and maintained the integrated data platform and analytical framework for a 30-page antimicrobial stewardship dashboard used to monitor key stewardship indicators across hospital departments. Integrated four independently developed components into a unified reporting system, ensuring data quality, reproducible workflows, semantic model consistency, and deployment readiness across multiple hospital sites.

entries.title: DATA SCIENTIST
org: INSEE (National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies)
lines: Responsible for annual salary database production and research on wage gaps in France.

points.label: Statistical Modelling and Data Analysis
points.text: Produced and published an official national analysis of public–private wage differentials in France using Oaxaca–Blinder regression on a 40M-record annual salary database, quantifying structural and unexplained components of wage gaps.

points.label: ETL Pipeline Development
points.text: Designed, implemented, and maintained robust ETL pipelines to standardise occupational data across 1.5M+ records, reducing redundancy by 17% and significantly improving data quality and interoperability across systems.

points.label: Data Validation
points.text: Investigated and resolved anomalies arising from complex data collection processes, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility of official statistics.

points.label: Reporting
points.text: Analysed wage dynamics during the COVID-19 period, identifying structural shifts through longitudinal data analysis. Redesigned and presented annual reports on key French wage statistics using R Markdown.

entries.title: DIGIT RECOGNIZER: MNIST COMPUTER VISION COMPETITION

points.text: Built and iteratively optimised a CNN model to classify handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset. Applied deep learning techniques including image preprocessing, data augmentation, dropout regularisation, and model evaluation. The final model achieved 99.9% accuracy, ranking in the top 2.5% of the leaderboard as of June 2025.

Built a custom time series forecasting model using XGBoost with expanding window validation to predict daily warehouse orders, achieving less than 5% MAPE. Engineered time-based and holiday-related features, applied Optuna for hyperparameter tuning to ensure robust performance.

Developed a classification model to predict customer response likelihood to a marketing campaign, achieving a 90% ROC-AUC score, and performed precision-recall analysis to evaluate conversion potential. Optimised the final model for profitability, enabling marketing strategies that improved ROI through prediction-driven decision thresholds.
